# discord_channel_permission (List Resource)

Lists the permission overwrites of every channel in a server, or of one channel.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "discord_channel_permission" "all" {
  provider         = discord
  include_resource = true

  config {
    server_id  = var.server_id
    channel_id = var.channel_id
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `server_id` (String) ID of the server (guild) to list permission overwrites of.

### Optional

- `channel_id` (String) Only list the permission overwrites of this channel.
